findings.note: Distinct project ratsight-full-local, owned volume, free-port ownership, and project-scoped teardown proven by V-UP, V-PURGE, V-RECREATE; shared infra container Up 41 hours and volume CreatedAt unchanged.

Hash mismatch on the first and on the second source both exit non-zero with 'no database writes happened', and canary max(updated_at) did not move (V-MISMATCH, V-SECOND); missing source in inspect-only exits 2 without download (V-INSPECT).

Inventory and UI keep UNVERIFIED and reference-only limits: dataset/resource version, archive SHA-256, licence, attribution, currentness, source-quality counts, 'Z dropped, no documented vertical datum', and '未驗證實際連通性' all rendered (V-STATUS, V-API, V-BROWSER).

Default up leaves rodent_reports empty with 'synthetic fixtures stay opt-in'; --synthetic prints the opt-in note, inserts 5 SIMULATED rows, and the UI labels them RODENT_REPORT · SIMULATED; a purge+default up returns to 0 (V-UP, V-SYNTH, V-SYNTHUI, V-RECREATE).
No sewer/manhole/trash-bin importer or migration exists; the doc records the candidates as assessment-only (V-CANDIDATE).
Cross-source preflight proven before writes for both sources, and ownership-safe discard/recreate of the owned environment proven without touching shared resources (V-SECOND, V-PURGE, V-RECREATE).
